titles.title: Untitled (Pink Spotted Lily)

description: Pink spots punctuate the smooth petals of a white lily. Curved green stamens emerge from its center. A green stem supports the flower. The vibrant bloom stands out against a beige background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
